about.title: About Us
about.body:
## Welcome to USA Viral 24N

USA Viral 24N (usaviral24n.com) is a website that brings together viral stories, trending topics and useful reads in one easy place. We aim to keep our articles simple, clear and easy to read on any device.

## What We Cover

- **News:** important stories and updates people are talking about.
- **Entertainment:** movies, celebrities, music and pop culture.
- **Health & Wellness:** general information on health topics, coverage questions and healthy living.
- **Trending:** stories that are spreading fast online.
- **Sports:** updates and talking points from the world of sports.

## Our Goal

Our goal is to give readers helpful and interesting content that is easy to understand. We try to write clear headlines, use relevant images and keep our pages simple to browse.

## Please Note

The articles on this website are for general information and entertainment. They are not professional medical, legal or financial advice. Please read our Disclaimer page for details.

## Get in Touch

We love hearing from our readers. If you have a question, a correction or a suggestion, email us at contact@usaviral24n.com or visit our Contact Us page.

Thank you for visiting USA Viral 24N..

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body:
## Contact Us

We would be glad to hear from you. Whether you have a question, feedback, a correction or a business enquiry, please get in touch.

**Email:** contact@usaviral24n.com

## What You Can Write to Us About

- Questions or feedback about an article.
- Corrections if you think something on the site is wrong.
- Copyright or content removal requests.
- Advertising and business enquiries.
- Any other question about USA Viral 24N.

## Response Time

We read every message and try to reply within a few business days. For faster help, please write a clear subject line and include the link to the page you are asking about.

Thank you for contacting USA Viral 24N.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
**Last updated: October 29, 2026**

This Privacy Policy explains how USA Viral 24N ("we", "us", "our") collects, uses and protects information when you visit usaviral24n.com. By using this website, you agree to this policy.

## Information We Collect

We do not ask visitors to create an account to read our articles. When you visit, certain information may be collected automatically, such as your IP address, browser type, device type, pages visited, time spent on pages and the website you came from. This information is used to understand how the site is used and to keep it secure.

If you contact us by email, we receive your email address and the details you choose to share, and we use them only to reply to you.

## Cookies

Cookies are small files stored on your device. We and our advertising partners may use cookies to remember your preferences, measure traffic and show ads. You can turn off or delete cookies in your browser settings. Some parts of the site may work differently if cookies are disabled.

## Advertising and Third Parties

We may show ads from third-party advertising networks, including Google. These companies may use cookies, web beacons and similar technologies to show ads based on your visits to this and other websites.

- Google uses advertising cookies to serve ads based on your visits to our site and other sites on the internet.
- You can manage personalised advertising at https://adssettings.google.com.
- You can also learn about opting out of interest-based ads at https://www.aboutads.info/choices.

We do not control the cookies used by third parties. Please read their privacy policies to learn how they handle your data.

## Links to Other Websites

Our articles may contain links to other websites. We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of those websites.

## Children's Privacy

Our website is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has shared personal information with us, please email us and we will remove it.

## Your Choices and Rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to ask what personal information we hold about you, to ask us to correct or delete it, or to object to how it is used. To make a request, email contact@usaviral24n.com.

## Data Security

We take reasonable steps to protect the information we collect. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

## Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version will always be on this page with the updated date at the top.

## Contact

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, email us at contact@usaviral24n.com.
